question_text: Outline why a renderer uses RAM while generating a 3D image from scene data.
adaptation_rationale: Narrows vague image-memory relationship to explicit primary-memory working role.
solution: RAM holds currently used geometry, textures and intermediate working results so the processor/GPU can access them during rendering.
